name: React Event Calendar
summary: Event calendar component for React with day, week, month and agenda views, built on shadcn/ui.
description: A calendar component for React applications that manages and displays events across day, week, month, year and agenda views, with theming through shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS v4. Built with Next.js, Zustand, Drizzle ORM, date-fns, nuqs and Framer Motion, with documentation (installation, architecture, API) and a demo app.
contains: calendar views: day, week, month, year and agenda
stack: React 18+, Next.js 15+, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, date-fns, nuqs, TypeScript
documentation: installation, architecture, customization and API
demo app with Zustand state and Drizzle ORM over PostgreSQL
